thread:
maria: quick follow-up from the 03:12am noise burst postmortem — aggregating action items here so we have visibility. main aims: reduce duplicate pages, stop paging on <5m spikes, and clarify owners for follow-through.

maria: we saw repeated pages from the same host within minutes (metric + anomaly engines), and a recurring pattern at ~2-4am the last two months.

devon: I can own the tracking and the incident board cards. will keep fixes scope-limited for the first sprint.

ashley: proposal: increase dedupe window and add a short `for` window on the CPU alert. current setup pages on any 1m avg >85% which catches transient cron spikes.

ashley: suggested change (example): ```alert: NodeHighCpu
expr: avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[2m]) > 0.85
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: high CPU {{ $labels.instance }}```

ashley: also suggest paging-rule suppression for host flapping: if host has >3 alerts in 10m, collapse to a single page and attach recent logs.

 tj: I ran a quick sweep — ~42% of CPU pages in last 60 days were <4m duration. I'll share a scatter plot and a small script to classify bursts vs sustained load.

 tj: script I used: `./scripts/alert-spike-stats --metric node_cpu_seconds_total --window 90d --min-duration 60s` — outputs durations + host counts.

devon: concrete plan: 1) bump dedupe to 15m in pager rules (owner: devon, ETA: 48h), 2) tighten CPU `for` to 3m and use 2m avg (owner: ashley, ETA: 72h), 3) run tj's classification and propose anomaly filter (owner: tj, ETA: 10d), 4) ops doc + retro summary (owner: maria, ETA: 5d).

oncall-bot: heads-up: any paging-rule changes need a paired firebreak window and a one-hour monitoring slot after rollout.

devon: scheduling firebreak today 11:00 UTC, will add rollback notes and the acceptance test steps to the PR.

ashley: long-term: look at exporter-side smoothing for flaky metrics and add a short LRU cache so scrapes don't spike on collector restarts. owner: ashley-infra, ETA: 6w.

sre-lead: +1 on conservative start. let's instrument a noise metric on the console (pages/hour after dedupe) and evaluate after 7 days; target >50% reduction without missing known incidents.

maria: please add the PR links and the validation checklist to the incident board when ready. small acceptance test per change: e.g., simulate a 2m CPU spike and confirm no page, then simulate a sustained 10m load and confirm page.

devon: adding cards now. will ping owners and link PRs. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — we'll sync up in two weeks to close remaining tasks and decide if dedupe window needs tuning.
